visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person films a small white square box placed on a light wood desk. Behind the box, a grey computer keyboard with various characters is visible under bright indoor lighting. A handwritten note addressed to 'Peter' from 'Susan' sits atop the box, instructing him to film before opening. (2) Hands with a white smartwatch reach in and open the white paper box. Inside are two black plastic blind bags with 'STARLUX' and 'CITY PRIMA' branding. The camera pans slightly to show a smartphone charging in the background next to some cables and a monitor stand. (3) The camera moves as the person walks into a brightly lit living and dining area. A woman wearing a grey 'Tom and Jerry' sweatshirt and black athletic shorts stands by a dining table, posing with peace signs. A golden retriever dog walks around her legs on the light-colored flooring. (4) The woman takes the black bags and stands in front of a large framed picture of Mickey Mouse on the wall. She smiles and talks directly towards the camera. A toddler girl in a pink shirt enters the frame, standing near the woman's legs and the dining table. (5) The woman carefully tears open the black plastic packaging while standing in the kitchen-dining area. She pulls out a small white and grey model airplane. She holds the toy up close to the camera lens, showing the 'STARLUX' logo and detailing on the miniature aircraft.
